about_body: I like the intersection where AI meets data that actually has to be correct. I write about what production teaches you, and I help businesses automate work nobody should be doing by hand.
about_lede: I'm Aakash, a Senior Data Engineer in Calgary. I build the unglamorous machinery companies run on — pipelines, warehouses, reconciliation jobs — and the production AI systems that sit on top of them.
contact_note: I take on a small number of automation projects for businesses. A report you hate making, a process held together by spreadsheets, an AI idea you're not sure is feasible — start here.
footer_note: Built by hand in Calgary — no skill bars were harmed.
